about: Shared canvas format cases for the Python and JavaScript readers. See README.md in this folder.

cases.name: valid-progress
cases.note: Design fixture. Canonical. All references exist.

cases.name: valid-launch-plan
cases.note: Design fixture. Canonical.

cases.name: valid-empty-object
cases.note: The smallest valid file. Writing adds the version and both lists.

cases.name: valid-empty-lists
cases.note: The canonical empty canvas.

cases.name: valid-pretty-printed
cases.note: Another tool wrote indented JSON in its own order. Groups go first, then nodes by id; upper case sorts before lower case.

cases.name: valid-unknown-keys
cases.note: Unknown keys at each level and an unknown node type are kept. Keys of nested objects are sorted.

cases.name: valid-numbers
cases.note: Whole numbers in any spelling become integers. Other numbers use the JavaScript number text.

cases.name: valid-bom-crlf
cases.note: A byte order mark and CRLF line ends are read. Writing removes them.

cases.name: valid-script-text
cases.note: Hostile: script text in a note, label, title, alt, and edge label is plain text. The format keeps it; the renderer must show it as text.

cases.name: valid-proto-keys
cases.note: Hostile: keys such as __proto__ and constructor are plain data and are kept.

cases.name: valid-unicode
cases.note: Escapes are read. Writing uses the character itself, except for the quote, the backslash, and control characters below U+0020.

cases.name: valid-text-20000-astral
cases.note: A note holds 20,000 characters. A character outside the basic plane counts as one.

cases.name: valid-limits-at
cases.note: Each string is at its longest allowed length.

cases.name: valid-500-nodes-1000-edges
cases.note: The largest allowed counts.

cases.name: valid-512-kib
cases.note: A canonical file of exactly 524,288 bytes is read.

cases.name: valid-nested-32
cases.note: Unknown data can nest to 32 levels. The top object is level 1.

cases.name: valid-version-2
cases.note: A newer profile version is read with the version 1 rules and marked read-only. Tools do not save it.

cases.name: valid-sides-ends
cases.note: Each side and end value, both colour forms, the size and position limits, and an edge from a node to itself.

cases.name: valid-group-background
cases.note: A group background, a canvas portal, a whole record, and a section in another letter case.

cases.name: valid-urls
cases.note: Addresses that the rule accepts. A script in the query is text in a link card.

cases.name: valid-dotted-paths
cases.note: Paths that look odd but have no "." or ".." part. The format accepts them; the reference rules then look for the file.

cases.name: valid-duplicate-key-last-wins
cases.note: A repeated key keeps its last value, as JSON readers do.

cases.name: valid-media-at-limit
cases.note: A media file of exactly 1,048,576 bytes is allowed.

sections.note: Generated section cards: one for each second-level heading, in order. A repeated id gets -2, -3; an empty slug is "section".
